style.styleTitle: Decoris Set of 3 Bottle Of Bubbles Christmas Baubles
style.toneOfVoice: <p>Celebrate the festive season with these sophisticated glass bottle ornaments, designed to bring a fun party atmosphere to your home. Each of the three miniature bottles is adorned with glitter accents and a delicate decorative bow, creating a sparkling effect that dances in the glow of Christmas lights. These playful highlights are the perfect addition for those looking to infuse their holiday décor with a sense of joy and celebration.</p><ul><li>Made of glass for a refined, festive appearance<br></li><li>Bottle-shaped figure with a height of 13.5 cm and diameter of 4.5 cm</li></ul>
style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted: This glass figure bottle is designed as a festive ornament for decorating a Christmas tree. The miniature bottle shape adds a cheerful party theme that blends easily with classic baubles and other decorations. Glitter accents and a decorative bow give the surface a sparkling look that reflects tree lights beautifully. On the tree, the ornament stands out as a playful highlight among branches and tinsel, bringing a celebratory Christmas atmosphere into the room. Made of glass for a refined, festive appearance. Bottle-shaped figure with a height of 13.5 cm and diameter of 4.5 cm. Assorted colors with glitter finish for a sparkling effect in the tree. Gold aluminum cap with decorative sticker detail for a champagne-style look. Gold wire hanger for easy suspension on Christmas tree branches.
